constants.ir_name: S<digits>_R<digits>_hybrid_IR.wav, s and r = int(digits) as in AR_md.py

selection.rule: From the train split file (a JSON object {category: {room_id: [IR file names]}}), for every room category (its top-level keys, processed in sorted order): rank the category's rooms by the hexadecimal sha256 of the UTF-8 string 'exp43-frame-audit:' + room_id (ascending; room_id breaks ties) and take the first 4 rooms (all of them if the category has fewer). In each selected room the candidate receivers are the receiver indices r of the room's IR names 'S<digits>_R<digits>_hybrid_IR.wav', parsed as AR_md.py parses them (r = int of the digits after 'R', leading zeros allowed: the split holds both 'S0010_R0010' and zero-padded 'S010_R010' styles; names of any other form are counted and unused); rank them by the sha256 of 'exp43-frame-audit:' + room_id + '/R' + str(r) (ascending; r breaks ties) and walk that order, skipping with a recorded reason every receiver without the regular file depth_map/<category>/<room_id>/<r>.npy and every receiver without any metadata JSON (position unknown), until 6 receivers are taken (fewer if the room has fewer). For every taken receiver every source s whose file metadata/<category>/<room_id>/S00{s}_R00{r}.json exists (exact canonical name, as AR_md.py builds it) is taken. Directory listings are sorted, so the result does not depend on listing order. A taken depth map must be a (256, 512) floating array, finite and >= 0 (zeros are rendering holes and are counted); every taken metadata JSON must hold 3 finite numbers in src_loc and in rec_loc, and all of a receiver's JSONs must give the identical rec_loc; any violation refuses the freeze. A selected room left without a receiver is recorded as skipped. This step reads files only to hash them and to validate their format; it computes no score.
